subject: Língua Inglesa
description_pt: Construir repertório lexical relativo a planos, previsões e expectativas para o futuro.

components.description_pt: Identificar vocabulário relacionado a planos futuros, previsões e expectativas em inglês
components.description_en: Identify vocabulary related to future plans, predictions, and expectations in English

components.description_pt: Usar expressões orientadas para o futuro para descrever planos pessoais ou coletivos
components.description_en: Use future-oriented expressions to describe personal or collective plans
components.cc_component_description: Use future-tense verbs correctly to describe actions yet to occur in writing

components.description_pt: Aplicar itens lexicais sobre previsões e expectativas em sentenças apropriadas ao contexto
components.description_en: Apply lexical items about predictions and expectations in context-appropriate sentences

components.description_pt: Distinguir entre vocabulário expressando planos, previsões e esperanças para o futuro
components.description_en: Distinguish between vocabulary expressing plans, predictions, and hopes for the future
components.cc_component_description: Distinguish between general vocabulary and domain-specific vocabulary for a given topic

cc_matches.description: Use verbs to convey a sense of past, present, and future (e.g., Yesterday I walked home; Today I walk home; Tomorrow I will walk home).
Use precise language and domain-specific vocabulary to inform about or explain the topic.
